content: Punto Switcher (Yandex, Windows 4.5.0 2024, macOS legacy): auto-switch via statistical analysis + dictionaries of impossible letter combos; manual hotkeys Pause=fix last text, Shift+Break=switch layout, Alt+Break=toggle case of selection/recent text; tray layout icon + floating cursor indicator; transliteration of selection; number-to-words; auto-replacement snippets; programs-exceptions tab; clipboard manager (30 entries); typed-text diary (privacy criticism); Yandex/Wikipedia integration (criticism). Selection has priority over tracked last word; mouse click clears tracking. Ecosystem lesson: false switches and per-app incompatibilities are the top complaints; extras (diary, cloud) hurt trust.
